description:
FILED s410 (Opus 5), found while implementing #378 -- op/sub.t:214 needs
`our $ok++, return if $depth == 2;` to work, or the now-real recursion never
terminates.  The `if`/`unless` half is FIXED in s410; this task is the
REMAINDER.

An `our` declaration with a LOOP statement modifier still loses its tail:

    our $z = ++$c while $c < 3;     # perl: loops      PCL: statement DROPPED
    our $z = 5 for 1..2;            # perl: runs twice PCL: statement DROPPED

Both pipelines route the same way.  v2's Parser2::_lower_our_decl and v1's
Parser::_process_our_declaration now split a trailing if/unless off and
re-apply it (_apply_modifier / the expression-statement path), but
_modifier_needs_fallback's four loop modifiers are left ATTACHED, so the run
still reaches PExpr with `while COND` in it and comes back
"Fell through. Missing case: []" -- an ANNOUNCED drop (`PCL: statement dropped
at F line N`), not a silent one, and countable in the drop census.

POPULATION: ZERO.  Measured s410 over perl-tests/*.t + perl's own t/*/*.t +
lib/**/*.pm: two `our`-with-modifier lines exist in the whole corpus and both
are `if` (op/sub.t:214, and a false hit -- `our sub if() { 42 }` in
op/lexsub.t, which is a lexical-sub declaration, not a modifier).

WHY IT WAS NOT DONE WITH THE if/unless HALF: `our $x = E while C` is
`while (C) { $x = E }` around a cell that is declared unconditionally, so the
fix is not one more _apply_modifier arm -- it needs the loop LOWERING, which
in v2 lives behind _fallback_stmt (the `my` path's answer for the same four
modifiers) and in v1 behind _process_expression_statement.  v1's half is in
fact already right: s410 routes the whole `NAMES <tail> MOD COND` run through
the expression-statement path, which owns all six modifiers.  It is v2's
_lower_our_decl that would have to hand the statement to _fallback_stmt
INSTEAD of pushing its own declarations first -- a restructure of that
function's side-effect ORDER (it pushes global_decl_form into _captured_decls
before it ever looks at the tail), not an added arm.  Do it when v2 owns the
loop modifiers, or fold it into Option B phase 2.

BAR: the four shapes above vs perl in BOTH pipelines (a named sub exercises
v2, an anon sub containing a `local` routes its whole body to v1 -- that is
the trigger, measured s410); census down by whatever the shapes contribute
(0 today); guard rows next to the s410 ones at the end of
Pl/t/our-local-01.t.

Related: #378 (the `__SUB__` work that found it), #343 / Option B phase 2
(the drop census this feeds).
subject: `our $x = E while COND` (and for/until/foreach) still drops the tail — the if/unless half was fixed in s410; the four loop modifiers need the loop lowering, which v2 keeps behind _fallback_stmt. Corpus population: ZERO
